meta.title: The Moat Moved Downstairs
meta.subtitle: How hyperscalers are buying power, capacity, and credit in the AI buildout
meta.author: Toluwalase Ayeni
meta.sources: Primary sources: company press releases, SEC filings, Bloomberg, CNBC, DCD. All capex per kW figures computed; disclosed vs imputed flagged.

ppaDeals.name: Project Kilby
ppaDeals.note: Vertically integrated gas to compute. Chevron builds, owns, operates generation behind the fence.

ppaDeals.name: Wichita & Mustang Creek
ppaDeals.note: Largest TotalEnergies US renewable PPA. Additive to the ERCOT grid, not behind the meter.

ppaDeals.name: Clearway portfolio
ppaDeals.type: Grid connected wind and solar PPA
ppaDeals.note: Three projects across Missouri, Texas, West Virginia including Goat Mountain wind repower.

maDeals.name: NextEra / Dominion merger
maDeals.structure: All stock, fixed exchange ratio (0.8138 NEE per D share)
maDeals.rationale: Creates the world's largest regulated utility; pro forma NEE ~74.5% / Dominion ~25.5%.

maDeals.name: AES take private
maDeals.structure: All cash take private, $15.00 per share
maDeals.rationale: Infra capital buying a listed IPP with data center contracted renewables at a 40% premium.

maDeals.name: Constellation / Calpine
maDeals.structure: Cash and stock (50M CEG shares + $4.5B cash)
maDeals.rationale: Creates the largest US power generator; nuclear plus gas fleet meeting AI demand.

maDeals.name: Capital Power / Hummel & Rolling Hills
maDeals.target: Hummel Station and Rolling Hills (from LS Power)
maDeals.structure: All cash asset purchase, US$2.2B net
maDeals.rationale: Strategic entry into PJM, the largest US power market.

maDeals.name: EQT / Copia Power
maDeals.rationale: Purest 'power is the product' platform trade in the AI infrastructure wave.

financingDeals.name: Hyperion JV
financingDeals.capitalPartners: Blue Owl (80% equity, ~$7B cash), PIMCO (~$18B debt anchor), BlackRock ($3B+), Morgan Stanley (arranger)
financingDeals.structure: Development JV via SPV; operating lease back to Meta (4 yr initial) + 16 yr capped residual value guarantee; A+ rated 144A bonds
financingDeals.creditSupport: Meta operating lease + 16 yr capped residual value guarantee
financingDeals.note: Meta contributed the under construction campus and received a $3B one time payout. Auction ran Apollo + KKR vs PIMCO + Blue Owl; 144A format won for syndication.

financingDeals.name: Hyperion 5GW expansion
financingDeals.structure: Scope revision; expansion financing undisclosed (same JV, second vehicle, or balance sheet)
financingDeals.note: 2GW to 5GW, $27B to $50B+. Entergy package: 10 gas plants (5.2GW), 2.5GW renewables, 240 mi transmission, est. $2.65B customer benefits over 20 yrs, $1B+ community infrastructure. Watch item: who funds the ~$23B delta.

financingDeals.name: Stargate Abilene
financingDeals.capitalPartners: Blue Owl Real Assets, Primary Digital Infrastructure, JPMorgan ($2.3B loan)
financingDeals.structure: Development JV; developer Crusoe; campus leased to Oracle
financingDeals.creditSupport: Oracle lease (OpenAI Oracle contract expanded to $300B over 5 yrs)
financingDeals.note: First Stargate site, ~1.2GW, 8 buildings. Related: Blue Owl ~$3B equity into Stargate New Mexico (up to 4.5GW, up to $18B loans).

financingDeals.name: Justified Data lease
financingDeals.structure: Direct 20 yr lease + two 5 yr renewal options; single tenant, purpose built
financingDeals.capexFlag: imputed ($3.2 to 4B analyst estimate, not disclosed)
financingDeals.creditSupport: Expected to be supported by an investment grade credit; supporter undisclosed (watch WULF filings)
financingDeals.location: Hawesville, KY (former Century Aluminum site, ~480MW available power)
financingDeals.note: Contracted revenue (~$19B) exceeds TeraWulf market cap (~$12B). The credit is the collateral: value rests on the tenant promise, not the building. Verified through extraction pipeline, Jul 2026.

financingDeals.name: Fluidstack Lake Mariner
financingDeals.capitalPartners: Google (lease backstop + warrant holder); project debt lenders undisclosed; Schneider Electric / Motivair (power and liquid cooling, $290M+ delivered)
financingDeals.structure: HPC colocation leases (CB-3, CB-4, CB-5); 10 yr initial terms + two 5 yr extension options; Google backstops Fluidstack lease obligations to enable project related debt financing; warrants issued to Google
financingDeals.creditSupport: Google backstop of Fluidstack lease obligations: $1.8B initial, raised to ~$3.2B with CB-5; warrants for ~41M + 32.5M shares (~14% pro forma equity stake)
financingDeals.location: Lake Mariner, Cayuga (Western NY); NYISO Zone A, ~89% carbon free power; dual 345 kV transmission
financingDeals.status: CB-3 (42MW) + CB-4 (162MW) announced Aug 14 2025; CB-5 (+160MW) Aug 18 2025; ~40MW live H1 2026, full buildout targeted by end 2026
financingDeals.note: Fluidstack's own deal and the template for the desk's playbook: a startup neocloud's 10 yr lease made bankable by Google's investment grade backstop. Google is customer, creditor, and ~14% shareholder at once. Rent ~$1.85M per MW year (computed from disclosed figures: $3.7B / 10 yr / ~200MW), below the Anthropic Hawesville rate of $2.4M; the spread reflects tenant, site, and term. Initial 200MW at ~$3.7B, up to ~$8.7B with extensions; full 360MW at ~$6.7B, up to ~$16B with extensions. Open question: GPU ownership and whether Google is the ultimate compute offtaker (watch WULF and Fluidstack disclosures). The disclosed supporter counterpart to the still undisclosed Anthropic Hawesville credit. Verified from WULF press releases and 8-K, Jul 2026.

thesis.argument: Model weights are becoming free; megawatts are not. As open weight models commoditize the middle of the stack, durable value migrates to the physical layer: chips, buildings, power, and interconnection. The structures in this deck are the best informed players locking up decades of that layer. Capital structure determines when and how you suffer if wrong, not whether.
